opportunity.title: Circle CVI software or equivalent for VA Portland Healthcare System
opportunity.description: Combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products and services under RFO 12.212(b)(1). Firm-fixed-price purchase order anticipated, set aside for small businesses (size standard 150 employees). The VA Portland Healthcare System seeks a base year plus two option years of Circle CVI or equivalent software and associated services. Service location: VA Portland Healthcare System, 3710 SW U.S. Veterans Hospital Road, Portland, OR. Base year 12/20/2026 to 12/19/2027, option years through 12/19/2029. Award based on the evaluation factors in Section E of the attached RFQ.

rationale.point: The opportunity requires AI-based cardiac imaging and reporting solutions (Claim #2), which is outside the company's demonstrated expertise in clinical scheduling and health records integration (company profile pastPerformance).

The firm-fixed-price contract (Claim #1) for specialized medical imaging software poses high technical and financial risk for a 9-person firm with no clearance and no relevant past performance (company profile capacityNotes, pastPerformance).
While the company meets eligibility (SBA set-aside, NAICS 541519, place of performance OR), the technical mismatch suggests low probability of competitive proposal.

risks: Significant technical capability gap in cardiac imaging AI software
Firm-fixed-price exposure with no relevant performance history
Lack of past performance in medical imaging or AI/ML domains
Potential need for teaming partners not currently identified
nextSteps: Assess availability of teaming partners with cardiac imaging expertise
Evaluate feasibility of acquiring or developing equivalent software within timeline
Focus business development on opportunities aligned with clinical scheduling and health records integration
